author: Sp4rrkii
body:
Hi there, I'm wondering at some point it would be possible if i became a mod because recently there have been quite a few hackers online with no moderators to shut em down. As Avicus is one  my favourite server, I am on frequently (almost everyday) and thus would be a good fit for the job, please let me know when apps are open or when i can apply ;D


Thanks, 
Spazzz

title: Looking to apply for mod - Spazzz :D !

replies.author: TooSweetSki
replies.body:
Hey spazzz!
There are two ways to get mod on this server.

Staff applications (which are currently closed)

And staff referrals (where you get asked by the staff to join the team)

Staff applications will probably open up again in a few months.

In the mean time, if you stay active on our platforms and interact with the community, by the time staff apps roll around, you'll be in with a good shot.
